description: Run a proposal exactly as shown — same model, same parameters, same price. Called by the card's button, or by you after the user confirmed. Single use: the proposal is consumed BEFORE the run, so a second call is refused instead of paying twice. Valid 15 minutes, for the account that created it. Costs credits. The run is checked against what you confirmed only when it FINISHES; poll lab_job_status and read review there. This answer carries review only if the run completed synchronously.

dreamer_signatur.description: Dreamer proof for prompt_override (from the previous answer's dreamer_signatur).

nur_eigene_daten.description: Only for a model that sends inputs to China or a US recipient without a documented basis, when the step carries images, clips, voices or faces. Means: this material shows or contains no real person other than the human using this account. Set it ONLY after the human has said exactly that for THIS step; never assume it, never reuse it for the next step. Not needed when the human has declared this material in the FilmLab app: the backend reads that declaration, also for material derived from it; only the app can store one. An LK reference, a licensed likeness or another person's agreement does not replace it. Without it the backend refuses with drittland_dritte_gesperrt before any charge; then use a non-gated model or text only.

ohne_keyframe.description: Skip the keyframe checkpoint on purpose. By default a paid clip only starts from a start image the user has approved (lab_review_asset verdict: accepted) — look at the frame first, then spend on the clip. Set true only when the user explicitly asked to skip the frame check.

prompt_override.description: Replace ONLY the prompt text of the stored proposal. Every other parameter — model, resolution, duration, references — and the price stay exactly as shown. This is the path for a prompt the user edited on the card: the price does not depend on the text, so no new proposal is needed. Standbild-Bewegung uses no model prompt; confirm that proposal unchanged. An edited text goes through the Dreamer first: without a matching dreamer_signatur the call does NOT run, the proposal stays valid, and the answer carries the Dreamer version to confirm.

vorschlag_id.description: The id from lab_propose or plan_b in lab_job_status. Do not construct one — an unknown id answers 'vorschlag_abgelaufen', not an error you can work around.
